text: Place a raw potato cut in half under the bed of someone who is sick and do not say a word. What happens to that potato in a single night may make you rethink everything you believe about healing. The potato is one of the most used tubers in traditional energy extraction practices. It grows underground in the darkness, absorbing invisible nutrients. And when you place it in a heavy environment, it keeps doing what it does best, absorbing. Do this. Take a raw potato and cut it in half. Hold both halves in your hands for a moment and say in silence, absorb what is heavy. Attract what is making this body sick. Remove what does not belong. Place both halves on a plate under the bed of the person who is ill or under your own bed. If you are the one feeling unwell, place them at the height of the torso. Do not tell anyone you did this. Silence protects the intention. Leave it there all night. The next morning look at the potato carefully. If it is dark, as if it had rotted in a single night, the energy there was heavy. The potato absorbed what was making the environment or the body sick. If it has green or purple spots or a strong smell, the weight was old. It had been building up for a long time. If it looks almost the same as when you placed it, the energy was lighter. Never cook that potato. Wrap it in paper and throw it away outside the house. Wash the plate with salt and water. If the potato darkens a lot. Repeat the process for three nights in a row and observe if there is a gradual improvement. Many people tell me the sick person wakes up with more energy. That the fever drops and that the discomfort fades without any apparent medical explanation. And do not be alarmed by what you find. Be alarmed by how long that person has been sleeping on top of that energy without anyone doing anything about it. Write in the comments, The potato absorbs. If you are going to try this tonight and come back to tell me what you found the next morning. And if you feel that it is not just one ritual you need, but that you want to learn how to release what makes the body sick from the inside. How to protect your energy, calm your mind and heal in ways that go far beyond what any single practice can do on its own. I spent over twenty years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
